item.title: Lansing School District announces record graduation rate
item.description: LANSING, Mich. (WLNS) -- The Lansing School District reached a historic 93.81% four-year graduation rate for the 2024–2025 school year, marking the highest performance in the district's history. During the same period, the district successfully reduced its dropout rate to 1.75%. These figures represent a significant lead over Michigan statewide averages. According to official state [...]

item.title: Mackinac Island begins hiring for 2026 season
item.description: LANSING, Mich. (WLNS) -- Mackinac Island businesses are recruiting nearly 5,000 seasonal employees to staff the island for the 2026 season. item.title: Nick Reiner pleads not guilty in LA slayings of parents Rob and Michele Reiner
item.description: Nick Reiner pleaded not guilty in a downtown Los Angeles courtroom Monday in connection with the killings of his parents, Hollywood director Rob Reiner and his wife, Michele Singer Reiner, late last year.

item.title: Peter Attia departs CBS News after communications with Epstein surface
